# Creatio | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning in a single sentence | The AI Native CRM and uncoded automated platform covering sales, marketing and services, with emphasis on modular applications and business processes. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | Implementation of complexity and governance costs above light CR; minimum procurement amount, AI quota, professional services and localization capacity to be split. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | Implementation complexity and governance costs are higher than lightweight CRM; minimum purchase amount, AI quota, professional services and localization capabilities need to be split in the quotation. |
